product.name: Pinkmint Men's Solid Shirt
product.description: A men's solid full-sleeve regular-fit shirt made from cotton blend fabric, featuring a button-down collar and standard length. Designed primarily for casual and everyday wear, with styling suitable for office and semi-formal occasions.

buying_advice.size_advice: Available sizes are S through 2XL. Reviews are mixed on fit, so Shopi should direct the shopper to the size chart rather than claiming that the shirt always runs true to size.
buying_advice.fabric_advice: Call it a Cotton Blend. Do not convert this into '100% cotton' or 'pure cotton'.
buying_advice.quality_advice: Position quality as average-to-good for the price, not premium. The review evidence is too inconsistent to justify a premium-quality claim.
buying_advice.value_advice: ₹399 is the strongest selling point. The product makes more sense as a budget/value recommendation than as a quality-first recommendation.
buying_advice.occasion_advice: Best positioned for casual, everyday and office-casual use. It can be used for semi-formal styling, but should not be Shopi's first choice for a formal-shirt query.
buying_advice.color_advice: Color accuracy is a meaningful risk. Shopi should avoid saying that the actual shade will exactly match the product image.

shopi_ai_rules.fit_rule: Describe the listed fit as Regular Fit, but do not guarantee fit because reviews are mixed.

shopi_ai_rules.occasion_rule: Prioritize casual, daily wear and office-casual queries.

shopi_ai_rules.color_rule: Only expose Black, Blue, Grey, Maroon, Navy Blue and Yellow because these are the six supplied SHIRT-014 images.

shopi_ai_rules.comparison_rule: For shoppers prioritizing reviews, quality consistency or exact color matching, rank SHIRT-014 below products with stronger ratings and fewer color complaints.
